startIn.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a made-up square frame, about 17 by 17 in

expandedIn.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: nothing extends past the frame during the auto

centreOfRotationIn.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: the middle of the frame

heightIn.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a low robot that fits under the hive pivot bar

maxForwardVelInPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a typical mecanum top speed; set it from Pedro's forward velocity tuner

maxStrafeVelInPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: about 80 percent of forward, as mecanum usually is; set it from Pedro's strafe velocity tuner

forwardDecelInPerS2.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a typical coasting deceleration; set it from Pedro's forward deceleration tuner

strafeDecelInPerS2.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a typical coasting deceleration; set it from Pedro's strafe deceleration tuner

accelInPerS2.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a typical mecanum launch rate until a sim or robot run calibrates it

maxAngularVelRadPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: a typical mecanum turn rate

defaultPathSpeedFraction.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: 85 percent of top speed on every path that sets none

settleS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: time for the follower to settle at the end of a path

mouths.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: one roller intake across the front of the frame, flush with the front edge

capacity.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: the hopper holds 4 pollen, the most a BIOBUZZ robot may hold

settleS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: time for the robot to stop rocking before the first launch

commands.name: shootAll
commands.summary: Spins the launcher up and launches count pollen from the hopper into the alliance's up hive cell. The launcher is fixed at the back of the robot. The precise cadence waits for the flywheel to recover between launches; rapid does not. The robot must stand still while it runs.

commands.name: setIntake
commands.summary: Sets the intake on one side. This robot has only a front intake: FRONT and BOTH run it, BACK does nothing.

commands.name: launcherIdle
commands.summary: Drops the launcher to its idle speed.

commands.name: relocalize
commands.summary: Re-reads the pose from the odometry computer and gives it to the follower. This robot has no camera, so the pose does not change.

commands.name: cancelAll
commands.summary: Stops the intake, the feeder and the launcher at once.

conditions.name: hopperFull
conditions.summary: The hopper holds 4 pollen: all four slot sensors see one.

conditions.name: hopperEmpty
conditions.summary: The hopper holds no pollen: no slot sensor sees one.
